name: GMX Measurement Only Character Count Step
overview: Tallies the [GMX-V 2.0](http://www.xtm-intl.com/manuals/gmx-v/GMX-V-2.0.html) `MeasurementOnlyTextUnitCharacterCount` category — the character count from measurement-only text units. Each text unit's source is tokenised and a unit qualifies as measurement-only based on its `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` tokens; units that also contain other content contribute zero, after which characters are counted over the `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` tokens. Characters are counted in canonical form — whitespace and punctuation are excluded (hyphens and apostrophes inside words are kept) — and stored as GMX-V metrics annotations for downstream consumption (for example by the Scoping Report Step). This is the character-count counterpart of the measurement-only word-count step.
processingNotes: Qualification keys on the `DATE`, `TIME`, and `CURRENCY` token kinds; a unit containing other non-whitespace content yields zero.
Counts are computed over the source content; only translatable text units are counted.
Character counting excludes whitespace and punctuation per GMX-V, but retains hyphens and apostrophes that occur inside a word.
